smart_money_signal_summary.interpretation: Smart money is divided. Pre-IPO/early investors (Berkshire, Tiger, ICONIQ) have exited or heavily reduced -- consistent with 'original thesis played out' rather than bearish conviction. Growth-oriented active managers (Fidelity, Jennison) are adding, suggesting belief in AI data cloud transition. Hedge fund community net reducing exposure. Insider selling is meaningful but CEO is notably NOT selling. Overall: institutional ownership stable at ~64% but composition shifting from early/value investors to growth/momentum managers.
